user_story: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings by 'pending' status
steps: Select 'pending' from the status filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with 'pending' status are displayed

positive.title: Filter bookings by 'confirmed' status
steps: Select 'confirmed' from the status filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with 'confirmed' status are displayed

positive.title: Filter bookings by 'cancelled' status
steps: Select 'cancelled' from the status filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with 'cancelled' status are displayed

negative.title: Attempt to filter with an invalid status
steps: Select 'invalid' from the status filter dropdown
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating invalid status selected

edge.title: Filter when there are no bookings
steps: Navigate to the bookings page with no existing bookings
Select 'pending' from the status filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: Message indicating no bookings available is displayed
